source_refs.note: 'Presenting Findings Clearly' under topic 7.7, as printed (PDF 103, printed 99).

blocks.text: Presenting findings clearly helps readers easily understand research outcomes. Results should be organized in a logical and structured way. Tables, charts, and graphs can be used to support explanations. Simple language should be used instead of technical jargon. Key points must be highlighted for better understanding. Clear presentation reduces confusion and improves communication. Well-presented findings make the research more effective and useful.
